Alchemist.description: A specialist in the creation of magical elixirs and mutagenic concoctions.

3.name: Tool Proficiency
3.tldr: Gain proficiency with alchemist's supplies, or expertise in them if already proficient.

3.name: Alchemist Spells
3.tldr: Always have a set list of alchemy-themed spells prepared, not counting against your number of prepared spells.

3.name: Experimental Elixir
3.tldr: Magically create random beneficial elixirs, such as healing or resistance, whenever you finish a long rest.

5.name: Alchemical Savant
5.tldr: Add your Intelligence modifier to the damage or healing of certain spells cast while holding alchemist's supplies.

9.name: Restorative Reagents
9.tldr: Your experimental elixirs can grant temporary hit points, and creatures healed by your spells regain additional hit points.

15.name: Chemical Mastery
15.tldr: Gain resistance to acid and poison damage, immunity to the poisoned condition, and the ability to craft rare potions.

Armorer.description: A specialist who fashions a suit of powered armor into a magical, weaponized exoskeleton.

3.name: Tool Proficiency
3.tldr: Gain proficiency with heavy armor, or expertise with an existing armor proficiency.

3.name: Armorer Spells
3.tldr: Always have a set list of defense-themed spells prepared, not counting against your number of prepared spells.

3.name: Arcane Armor
3.tldr: Turn a suit of armor into a set of powered arcane armor that you can don or doff quickly and that replaces your other armor proficiencies.

3.name: Armor Model
3.tldr: Choose a model for your arcane armor, the Guardian (built for close-quarters battle) or the Infiltrator (built for stealth and mobility).

5.name: Extra Attack
5.tldr: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

9.name: Armor Modifications
9.tldr: Install extra magical infusions directly into your arcane armor, and share some of the armor's benefits with a nearby ally.

15.name: Perfected Armor
15.tldr: Your arcane armor model gains an additional, more powerful ability depending on whether it's a Guardian or an Infiltrator.

Artillerist.description: A specialist who conjures a magical cannon to unleash bursts of elemental damage.

3.name: Tool Proficiency
3.tldr: Gain proficiency with woodcarver's tools, or expertise if already proficient.

3.name: Artillerist Spells
3.tldr: Always have a set list of blasting-themed spells prepared, not counting against your number of prepared spells.

3.name: Eldritch Cannon
3.tldr: Spend an hour to magically create a small mobile cannon that can attack, shield allies, or heal, and that you can command.

5.name: Arcane Firearm
5.tldr: Turn one of your magic items with a spellcasting focus into an arcane firearm, adding a die of damage to your artificer spells.

9.name: Explosive Cannon
9.tldr: Your eldritch cannon deals extra damage, and you can cause it to explode for a burst of force damage when destroyed.

15.name: Fortified Position
15.tldr: You and your allies gain half cover from any eldritch cannon you've created, and you can maintain two cannons at once.

Battle Smith.description: A specialist who forges a steel companion and channels battle magic to protect their allies.

3.name: Tool Proficiency
3.tldr: Gain proficiency with smith's tools, or expertise if already proficient.

3.name: Battle Smith Spells
3.tldr: Always have a set list of protection-themed spells prepared, not counting against your number of prepared spells.

3.name: Battle Ready
3.tldr: Gain proficiency with martial weapons, and can use Intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls with magic weapons.

3.name: Steel Defender
3.tldr: Magically create a loyal steel defender construct that fights alongside you and can be commanded as a bonus action.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.tldr: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

9.name: Arcane Jolt
9.tldr: When you or your steel defender hits with an attack, deal extra force damage or restore hit points to a creature.

15.name: Improved Defender
15.tldr: Your steel defender gains a boost to its abilities, and your arcane jolt grows more powerful.
